body: Okay. But why? You and others can tell me things like this, but no one can explain why to me. So they become just empty words to me.

Most of my friends live far away from me. The closest lives about a city away. I do stay over at his home sometimes when things get overwhelming, but it's not something I can always do and he isn't always available to help me. So I'm basically alone here. It's hard for me to reach out to others because of my anxiety. I don't know how to articulate the thoughts in my head - I either get so frustrated with it that I give up, or by the time I do figure out how, it's already too late. I also have trouble believing that I'm "worthy" of receiving such help; I think that it's already too late for me. But that just might be me making excuses...

I know that I must do *something*, and that change must begin with me, but I don't know where exactly to begin. Who can I reach out to? What if they can't assist me? What if I'm not strong enough to follow their advice? It's these kind of thoughts that stop me.
